VETERINARY HPM® Urology Cat Food U3 is a clinical complete dry cat food to help limit the formation of bladder stones (struvite and oxalate) and help in the management of feline idiopathic cystitis (FIC), with the inclusion of green tea concentrate which is a natural source of L-theanine and has been shown to help modulate mood and stress. It can be used for long-term management of lower urinary tract disorders.
This dietary formula provides all the daily nutrition your cat needs while:

  * Limiting the formation of struvite and calcium oxalate stones
  * Stimulating water intake to increase urine volume and urination
  * Balancing the pH of urine by diluting and acidifying it with a high protein and sodium content
  * Binding phosphorus to reduce the recurrence of both struvite and oxalate stones
  * Helping to lower urinary tract inflammation with a high level of omega-3 fatty acids (EPA + DHA)
  * Helping to manage feline idiopathic cystitis

VETERINARY HPM® Urology Cat Food U3 comes in convenient resealable bags weighing 1.5 kg and 3 kg. Follow the feeding guidelines on the package for your cat’s body weight to provide the ideal daily ration. This food is only suitable for adult and senior cats not diagnosed with chronic kidney disease or cardiac insufficiency. Do not use during growth stages (kittens and junior cats) or while pregnant or lactating.
## Benefits

With a high protein content (44%), your cat will drink up to 25% more water, thereby increasing urination by 30% to pass struvite stones. It balances the pH of urine and helps to reduce urinary tract inflammation to prevent new struvite and oxalate stones. Fortified with Behaviour Plus Complex to help manage stress.

VETERINARY HPM® Urology Cat Food U3 is formulated with a high protein content (44%). This helps to stimulate water intake which increases urine volume and urination, which helps to limit the formation of new stones. For cats that have been diagnosed with Feline Idiopathic Cystitis stress management is an important consideration, so the formulation also contains green tea concentrate to provide a natural source of L-theanine, which has been shown to have relaxing properties.

citeturn446search5 [wordlim: 200] Crawled: today; Content type: text/html; VETERINARY HPM® Urology Cat Food U1 is a complete short-term diet (5-12 weeks) that helps to dissolve and reduce the formation of struvite stones and can also ...
VETERINARY HPM® Urology Cat Food U1 is a complete short-term diet (5-12 weeks) that helps to dissolve and reduce the formation of struvite stones and can also be used to reduce the recurrence of a different sort of urinary tract deposit called oxalate stones.
This dietary formula provides all the daily nutrition your cat needs while:

  * Dissolving struvite stones in an average of 14 days with a relative supersaturation of <1 to promote rapid struvite stone dissolution. RSS is the measure of how likely a crystal is likely to form and is a unique scale for each type of crystal
  * High protein stimulates water intake to encourage increased urination which is important when managing urinary health.
  * Acidifying urine with a high protein and sodium content to increase the dissolution of struvite stones.
For long-term dietary control we recommend changing over to VETERINARY HPM® Urology Cat Food U2 after 5-12 weeks on VETERINARY HPM® Urology Cat Food U1.
The VETERINARY HPM® clinical diet range helps to manage several conditions and is more adapted to feline carnivore needs thanks to its low carbohydrate and high protein content (moderate in the case of kidney disease).
## Benefits

This clinical diet is indicated for a short term use of 5 to 12 weeks to help dissolve struvite stones and limit the formation of calcium oxalate stones. The high protein and sodium content makes your cat drink more, thereby increasing urine volume and urination It contains high levels of omega 3s which have been shown to help limit inflammation.
